annotations.exact_quote: Consistency regularization for deep semi-supervised clustering with pairwise constraints
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确为深度半监督聚类，属于利用可学习神经表示进行聚类划分的研究任务。

annotations.exact_quote: deep semi-supervised clustering with pairwise constraints
annotations.reason_zh: 标题表明以成对约束作为有限监督，结合未标注数据进行半监督聚类。

annotations.exact_quote: To leverage the additional structure of unlabeled data and to uncover more information hidden by pairwise constraints, we add a consistency regularization loss, calculated on unlabeled data and pairwise constraints, to our objective function.
annotations.reason_zh: 监督信号仅为成对约束而非完整实例标签，属于不完整监督并作为核心训练条件。

annotations.exact_quote: After consistency training, the connected data can be closer in the learned feature space, while the disconnected data can be far away.
annotations.reason_zh: 通过成对约束使相连样本在学得特征空间靠近、不相连样本远离，体现样本对吸引与区分表示学习。

abstentions.reason_zh: 仅见将成对约束直接用于一致性正则损失，未见扩展或传播must-link/cannot-link监督关系的证据。
有一致性训练利用未标注数据，但摘要未明确模型预测作为伪标签或后续训练信号。
